content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Soft cotton hoodie, relaxed fit, hip-length, oat beige #D2B48C, jersey knit. High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight cut, ankle length, stone gray #F5F5F0, sustainable rayon blend. White canvas slip-on sneakers, rounded toe, mid-foot height, pure white #FFFFFF, durable textile with a non-slip rubber sole. This ensemble starts with a comfortable hoodie perfect for warming up during your morning yoga session without restricting movement. The wide-leg trousers provide freedom of motion while the neutral tones keep the look grounded and effortless. Finally, the flat white sneakers respect your wish to avoid heels and prints, ensuring comfort as you transition from the studio to your coffee date."}
